---
# A figure note in a document with lang: de.
#
# Should: begin the note with Quarto's own German for "Note" (its
# callout-note-title, "Hinweis"), and still give the words Quarto does not
# translate, such as the Author Note heading, their English defaults.
#
# A guard rather than a fix: apaquarto's English defaults are kept out of
# _extension.yml, in apalanguage.lua, so that none of them can stand in for a
# translation. This goes off if one of them ever does.
title: "Eine Abbildung"
shorttitle: "Abbildung"
lang: de
author:
  - name: A B
    corresponding: true
    email: a@b.edu
    affiliations:
      - name: X
format:
  apaquarto-html: default
  apaquarto-docx: default
  apaquarto-typst: default
  apaquarto-pdf: default
---
